## Decision In One Sentence

that can produce the exact inputs for a later development decision; it does not
recommend pretending that the presently missing scientific and execution
bindings are already known.

## Why Gate 0 Comes First

The accepted framework requires exact historical-control, profile, population,
metric, inference, candidate-family, access, resource, and execution bindings
before development and a complete prospective freeze before qualification.
They are not yet available. Gate 0 is therefore preparation, not method
development: it may identify and draft those objects but cannot generate
scientific outcomes.

## Review Boundary

The owner can decide whether the Gate-0 activities, firewall, branch isolation,
human-only Unity boundary, stop rules, and required output are adequate.

The owner cannot approve a recurrence, method, parent route, empirical result,
profile, population, threshold, development run, held-out qualification,
qualified-method record, implementation-blind author packet, Stage B dispatch,
fallback, readiness, or production action from this packet.

## Present State

The direct instruction to preserve the accepted sequence is recorded. The
direct instruction to prepare this packet is recorded. Neither instruction is
treated as approval of the exact Gate-0 candidate, which is presented here for
separate content-bound review.
